decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the rear extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.

Condition : 5 - The first floor rear facing bathroom window of the two storey side extension shall only be provided in obscure glass, details of which shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.  In addition, the window shall be fixed, i.e. non-openable, to a point 1.6 metres above floor level. The window shall be provided in accordance with the details as approved and shall be retained as such.

Condition : 6 - The two storey side extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 1 Alfred Road Feltham   ].

Condition : 7 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed erection of a two storey and part single storey side extension and a single storey rear extension, by reason of positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, are considered to be acceptable having due regard for the existing building, the site characteristics, the street scene and the immediate local area.  The proposal would not be harmful to the character and appearance of the house, the street scene or local area; neither would it have an undue effect on and be harmful to the amenities of any neighbouring properties.  The development is considered to be in accordance with the relevant provisions of adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), and ENV-H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions), of the adopted Unitary Development Plan, and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of two storey and part single storey side extension and single storey rear extension to house
